label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: A thing moves another in some respect only insofar as…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: movet autem aliquid secundum quod est actu
interpretation: The mover is in act in the same respect in which it moves, as fire actually hot makes wood actually hot. In-act is left abstract, so the statement does not settle whether the mover must possess the perfection formally (univocal causation) or may possess it virtually; it only requires that the same notion of act satisfy the non-simultaneity premise.
